description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisitions of land in Midigama, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District and Aluthnuwaragama, Mawanella D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of Land Acquisition Notices published under The Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land acquisitions, provides descriptions of land parcels (including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and location details), and announces the deposit of compensation funds for these land acquisitions. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
